title: PMO-Dock: Benchmarking Docking, Specificity, and Generalization in Molecular Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19011v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design. As the field has moved to docking-based objectives, evaluation practice has become unstandardized, and different methods report results on different docking tasks, often without a shared protocol for fair comparison or sample-efficiency constraints. To address this, we introduce Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking (PMO-Dock), a benchmark and protocol for docking-based optimization consisting of 25 tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and a new specificity task requiring strong on-target binding while penalizing off-target interactions. translated_title: PMO-Dock：分子优化中对接、特异性与泛化能力的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19011v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：实用分子优化基准（PMO）规范了分子优化领域的评估标准，但它建立在简单的基于性质的评估函数之上，无法反映基于结构的药物设计。随着该领域转向基于对接的优化目标，评估实践变得缺乏标准化，不同的方法在不同的对接任务上报告结果，通常缺乏用于公平比较的共享协议或样本效率约束。为解决这一问题，我们提出了面向对接的实用分子优化基准，这是一个基于对接优化的基准测试和评估协议，包含25个任务，涵盖苗头化合物生成、先导化合物优化，以及一项新的特异性任务——该任务要求分子对靶标具有强结合能力，同时对脱靶相互作用进行惩罚。该协议将模型开发与最终评估分离：验证任务用于超参数调优，测试任务则被保留用于最终评估，且在开发过程中不使用……
tldr: 提出了包含25个基于对接的分子优化任务的PMO-Dock基准测试，涵盖苗头化合物生成、先导化合物优化和特异性评估，并通过将模型开发与最终评估分离的标准化协议，解决了基于对接的分子优化评估缺乏统一标准的问题。
en_tdlr: PMO-Dock is a benchmark of 25 docking-based molecular optimization tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and specificity, with a standardized protocol that separates model development from final evaluation to address the lack of unified evaluation standards in docking-based molecular optimization.
